invariants.rationale: Method always returns either style.disabledKnob or style.knob, which are likely non-null fields when disabledKnob is selected.
Method returns either style.disabledKnob if disabled and it is non-null, otherwise style.knob.
If style.disabledKnob is null, result will be style.knob, ensuring result is not affected by a null disabledKnob.
If the method takes the first return, result is definitely style.disabledKnob.

invariants.expression: !(disabled && style.disabledKnob != null) && result == style.knob || (disabled && style.disabledKnob != null) && result == style.disabledKnob
invariants.rationale: Covers the relationship between input conditions and exactly which field is returned.
